name: Reinforcement learning

conventions.text: Name each learned function only by a single italic letter set on or beside its arrow (h, g, f; E, D, G, pi), with no module box, and draw the letter and its arrow in that function's own colour.
conventions.conflicts_with: derive.md § 3 'names, not formulas': a learned function is a named block (lint symbol-heavy); single letters on arrows are what the user rejected as symbol clutter (2026-11-14)

conventions.text: Unroll the process left to right along time, one column or slot per time step, so the trajectory reads as a horizontal chain.
Label states, actions and rewards with math symbols indexed by time step (s_t, a_t, r^k, a_{t+k}).
Grey out what is context and keep only the active path in colour: the search-tree nodes off the unrolled path, or the conditioning options that are not wired in.
Keep the drawing in line art: no filled module boxes, shading or 3-D; thin strokes, coloured arrows and math labels carry the content.
conventions.conflicts_with: semantic colour: one fill per meaning, never drained to line art (design.md, lint palette-washed; user 2026-11-13: white/monochrome figures read unfinished)

conventions.text: Stand in for observations and data sources with small flat pictograms (a game board, a labeller avatar, a stack of documents).
Separate the phases (acting vs training, step 1 / 2 / 3) with thin light-grey rules, not with frames or tinted panels.
conventions.conflicts_with: a stream or stage the text separates is an enclosed, titled unit (validator, layout.md § 0); thin rules do not group

source: summarised from the evidence cards listed under each convention
